name: Dreamlike Story Title Card
description: A calm illustrated sleep-story cover with one gentle subject or quiet setting and a large, luminous gold-serif episode title.
composition_guidance: Create a low-arousal 16:9 sleep-story cover with one gentle subject or quiet setting, rendered in amber, moonlit blue, or candle gold illustration. Reserve a large, uncluttered title-safe field for the complete episode title, keeping the reading path calm and leaving visual rest around the subject and title card.
composition_rules: Show one gentle subject or one quiet setting as the undisputed focus.
Use a spacious low-arousal title-safe field with no competing labels or decoration.
Balance moonlit blue, amber, or candle-gold illumination without spectacle.
Keep the title field and focal subject immediately legible at small-screen size.
required_elements: One gentle subject or quiet setting
Amber, moonlit-blue, or candle-gold illustrated light
A large calm gold-serif full episode-title card rendered by the image model
avoid_elements: Violence, visual peril, urgency, cliffhangers, or alarming faces
High-contrast spectacle, loud saturated neon, or dense collage
Watermarks, logos, channel branding, copied story titles, or copied trade dress
Malformed anatomy, malformed text, or post-render typography compositing
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly into one large calm gold serif title card. Set a short title on one or two balanced lines; use three balanced lines only when needed for readability. Do not copy a saved story title, channel prefix, logo, or fixed catchphrase.
visual_style_guidance: Keep the thumbnail recipe independent of the active visual style: it requires a gentle focus, luminous amber/moonlit/candle-gold light, a generous title-safe field, and a directly rendered full title. Medium, brushwork, character design, and palette nuance come from the selected style.
